title: The orphan sweep is wired only at runSidecar startup, so a marker that becomes …
description:
The orphan sweep is wired only at runSidecar startup, so a marker that becomes orphaned mid-session (operator ships/abandons its issue without a fresh sidecar boot) is not swept until the next process start. This satisfies AC6's 'and/or' placement and covers the boot-surface scenario, so it is non-blocking; adding a preflight-start call site would close the mid-session window if desired later.
